label: CN §1.2 reviewed v3
old: 已有工作在所解问题和系数定义上与本文各有区别。
new:
矩形槽的双向流动已有半解析研究。Ng[7]通过区域分解和特征函数匹配，求解两面矩形槽壁之间的无滑移压力驱动Stokes流，并研究两壁图案相移及壁距的影响。该问题与本文一平壁、一槽壁不同；其对称配置的中面不能替换为本文的无滑移平板。其沿槽等效滑移长度又使用两壁包络之间的清流层流量、明确排除槽腔流量，因此不能仅凭滑移长度直接取得本文包含全部流体的深度积分导度。

Mohammadi与Floryan[8]的压力损失研究采用可表示上下壁形状的傅里叶框架，允许一壁为平面，并在几何降阶检验中纳入矩形槽；矩形形状本身不能作为排除该研究的理由。其详细参数结果主要针对小幅正弦槽，区分平均壁位变化和几何引起的流动调制。首模态近似、完整数值解及实际展示的参数范围需要分开；这些结果尚未在本文的矩形几何、低惯性条件、参考尺度和通量定义下建立匹配，本文不将其直接作为逐点精度基准。

Stroock等[9]对一平壁、一小幅正弦起伏壁的压力驱动Stokes流进行分析，给出各向异性有效边界及斜槽引起横向流的解释，并作实验核查。因此，双向响应、有限壁距作用和各向异性引起的流向偏转本身均不作为本文的新发现。本文仍限于特定矩形槽族中局部立方律偏差及其后果的评价，以及单列补充组在指定分解下的梯度结构诊断，不由几何或分组形式不同推断首创。

已有工作在所解问题和系数定义上与本文各有区别。

label: EN §1.2 reviewed v3
old: The compared problems and coefficient definitions differ.
new:
Semi-analytical studies of directional flow in rectangular grooves are available. Ng [7] used domain decomposition and eigenfunction matching to solve no-slip pressure-driven Stokes flow between two rectangular-grooved walls, examining pattern phase shifts and wall spacing. This differs from the present flat-wall/grooved-wall problem; the mid-plane of his symmetric configuration cannot replace the present no-slip plate. Moreover, his longitudinal effective slip length uses only the clear-layer flux between the wall envelopes, explicitly excluding cavity flux, so the slip length alone does not provide the present conductance integrated over all fluid.

The pressure-loss study of Mohammadi and Floryan [8] uses a Fourier framework for the two wall shapes, permits a planar wall, and includes rectangular grooves in tests of geometry reduction. Rectangular shape alone therefore cannot exclude that study. Detailed parameter results mainly concern small-amplitude sinusoidal grooves and distinguish changes in mean wall position from geometry-induced flow modulation. The leading-mode approximation, the full numerical solution and the displayed parameter range must be distinguished. A matched comparison at the present rectangular geometry, low-inertia conditions, reference scales and flux definition has not been established here; these results are not adopted directly as a pointwise accuracy benchmark.

Stroock et al. [9] analyzed pressure-driven Stokes flow between a flat wall and a sinusoidally modulated wall of small amplitude, describing anisotropic effective boundary conditions and transverse flow induced by oblique grooves, with an experimental check. Directional response, wall-confinement effects and anisotropy-induced flow deflection are therefore not presented as new findings here. Our assessment remains limited to local-cubic-law discrepancies and their consequences for a specified rectangular family, supplemented by a gradient-structure diagnostic under a defined decomposition on a separate set. Differences in geometry or grouping alone do not establish priority.

The compared problems and coefficient definitions differ.

label: CN §2.2 geometric reference height

new:
本文的 $H_{\rm ref}=V_f/A_{\rm plan}=h+d/2$ 是等宽槽与凸台下的几何平均开度，用于平均速度、深度积分通量与 $\kappa$ 的换算；它不同于通过匹配水力阻力定义的等效光滑通道开度，例如Mohammadi与Floryan[8] §4.4.2的 $EC_h$。

label: EN §2.2 geometric reference height
old: ### 2.3 Local cubic law and discrepancy definitions
new:
Here, $H_{\rm ref}=V_f/A_{\rm plan}=h+d/2$ is the geometric mean aperture for equal groove and ridge widths, used to convert between mean velocity, depth-integrated flux and $\kappa$; it differs from an equivalent smooth-channel opening defined by matching hydraulic resistance, such as $EC_h$ in Mohammadi and Floryan [8], Section 4.4.2.

(41)–(44) in Section 2.2 and related results. Both walls have rectangular grooves with no slip under pressure forcing. Its symmetric mid-plane is not the present no-slip plate, and longitudinal effective slip explicitly excludes cavity flux. Section 1.2 uses it for neighboring-problem and definition comparisons, not a matched flat-wall/grooved-wall numerical reference. The accepted and published versions have not been matched page by page.
- **[8] Mohammadi–Floryan 2013:** the 32-page published paper, printed pages 23–54, DOI 10.1017/jfm.2013.184, is available. Reading has advanced beyond the earlier abstract to targeted assessment of the [local published full text](../PAPER1_nearest_work_comparison_20261109/sources/round2/Mohammadi2013_jfm.pdf). Eqs. (2.1) and (4.5) and Figures 4–5 support the general wall-shape framework, a planar wall and rectangular-groove geometry-reduction tests. Section 4.4.2 defines $EC_h$ by matching friction factor, rather than the present geometric mean height. On 2026-11-10, Figure 6(b), printed page 34, was checked and contains $S=0.08$; $S=0.06$ is therefore not a method-applicability ceiling. The apparent high-wavenumber approach of $EC_h$ to $2-S/2$ was not computationally confirmed in the source and is not an established limit adopted here. Its examples have not been recomputed, a matched accuracy ranking at the present geometry, low-inertia conditions and flux definition has not been established, and it does not prove identity with our mechanism interpretation.
